short.lead: This is how the combined design you approved (1A on the overlap page) gets built: five steps under issue #406. Four of them already exist as issues #407 to #410 from October. The new one, the automatic save, is drafted but not opened yet, because the permission prompt for creating it timed out. The system document is docs/4-systems/usage-handoff.md. Everything is on the branch AjsAgent/session-handoff, which starts from main.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what it does and when it counts as done.
items: Automatic save on every branch (new step 5)

The existing subagent autosave is widened to every branch: at most once a minute, it saves a snapshot to refs/house-rules/autosave/<branch> and pushes it. A facts file goes inside each snapshot. The end of a turn, and a turn stopped by a usage limit, force one more save. Only files the agent wrote, plus changes to files git already tracks, are saved, so a stray secrets file is never pushed.
Done when verify.py finds the snapshot after an edit on an AjsAgent/ branch and on main, the branch itself is unchanged, and a live edit shows the snapshot on GitHub.
As approved in October, plus one row: a turn that changed files but left docs/5-today/Today.md alone is sent back once. Kept as a backstop behind the automatic save.
Done when verify.py replays each case (unpushed branch, stale note, forbidden link, Today.md untouched, nothing changed, fully saved) with the expected result.

Fetches the snapshots from GitHub within 5 seconds, then shows the branch's handoff note and the latest facts. If a snapshot has work the folder lacks, it lists the files and the restore command, and asks you before restoring anything.
Done when a fresh clone in a scratch folder shows the note, the facts and the missing files at session start.
Two design-loop bugs in project threads
Unchanged from October: a feature name that swallows message markup, and a quoted message from another thread that moves this thread's stage.
Rule text, docs, tests, version, a real run
The house-rules text names the save and the pickup, Today.md and ProjectState.md are updated, the plugin version goes up, and one real session on a second account picks up the first one's work.
Done when that second-account run is recorded with its output.
Creating the step 5 issue needs your yes on the GitHub permission prompt. Its text is drafted and goes in unchanged.
When you approve the plan, I open it and the prompt comes up once.
